subject: Next steps: procurement route, marketplace option & billing start for EdgeScale trial
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@edgescale.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@edgescale.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery + trial planning (recap & next steps)

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed set of next steps so we can align procurement and billing expectations for the pilot.

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: validate LLM inference at scale for EdgeScale's customer routing engine (90p latency < 120ms at 5 qps sustained, and embedding-based rerank accuracy not to regress >1.5% vs baseline).
- Trial footprint: 3 apps, expected average tokens: ~75k/day, peak 230k/day.
- Success criteria: 10k meaningful inference calls/day sustained for 7 continuous days + qualitatively acceptable latency/accuracy.

Procurement questions we flagged:
1) Preferred billing instrument: PO (net-30 invoice) vs corporate card?
2) Marketplace interest: Would you prefer we provision the trial via AWS Marketplace subscription (simpler procurement, but marketplace fees apply) or directly (no marketplace fee, direct contract)?
3) Contract vehicle: Standard Redwood terms ok (SLA + data isolation addendum), or do you need redlines ahead of PO?

Suggested next steps:
- You confirm procurement instrument (PO vs card) and whether to go marketplace by EOD 12/03.
- We provision a 30-day trial starting when you confirm (proposed start: 2027-01-03) and will instrument success metrics in the Console.
- Ben will share the SLA and invoice template for your procurement team.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_v1.2.pdf (SLA + uptime/latency targets), sample_invoice_template.xlsx

If you'd like, I can loop in our Contracts lead for quick redline turnaround.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Solutions (West)
Redwood Inference
—
Aisha Rahman | aisha.rahman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@edgescale.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@edgescale.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery + trial planning (recap & next steps)

Thanks Aisha — helpful recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

1) Procurement instrument: EdgeScale prefers to pay by PO / voucher and issue a net-30 invoice if acceptable. We have an existing process for vendor POs; our procurement lead will need an invoice template and the contract to attach.
2) Marketplace: We'd prefer NOT to use AWS Marketplace for the pilot (we want to avoid additional billing layers while evaluating).
3) Contract vehicle: Standard terms look fine at a glance; procurement would like to run a quick review — they requested the SLA and a sample invoice.

Two follow-ups for you: can the trial start window be flexible? We have a freeze from 12/20–12/31; earliest good start would be 01/04/2027. Also: are there model-variant choices for lower-cost inference (quantized) vs higher-fidelity? We want to test both.

Procurement contact: Maya R. <m.ramirez@edgescale.com> (she's on cc on the longer thread we'll forward to you).

Best,
Sofia
Product Lead, EdgeScale
sofia.patel@edgescale.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procure@edgescale.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@edgescale.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery + trial planning (recap & next steps)

Hi Maya / Sofia — looping in procurement to make the PO route smooth. Attaching SLA and a blank invoice/CO terms form for your team to complete.

Short answers to Sofia's questions:
- Start date flexibility: yes — we can schedule trial provisioning to start 2027-01-04. We'll hold a short provisioning window and confirm resource reservation.
- Model variants: absolutely. We'll provision two variants in the trial (quantized 8-bit for cost-sensitive runs, and a full-fp16 config for quality checks). We'll label them in the Console so you can A/B.
- Billing/who pays: since you prefer PO, we'll process via direct invoice (no marketplace fee). If you opt for marketplace later we can migrate.

Action items on our side:
- I attached Redwood_SLA_v1.2.pdf and EdgeScale_CO_terms_form.xlsx (please return the filled CO terms + signed signature page).
- I'll send a separate note with the invoice template and internal mailing address for PO submission.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_v1.2.pdf; EdgeScale_CO_terms_form.xlsx

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0147
From: Maya Ramirez <m.ramirez@edgescale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@edgescale.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery + trial planning (recap & next steps)

Thanks Ben / Aisha — procurement here. We've reviewed the SLA and the CO_terms form. A couple quick items before we circulate a PO internally: 

1) Billing start: We need the trial-to-paid conversion to be explicit. EdgeScale requests that billing start only after the trial meets the stated success criteria (10k meaningful calls/day for 7 days). Can you confirm Redwood can support an invoice start date that aligns with conversion date rather than trial provisioning date?
2) PO details we will include: billing address, Redwood tax id, contact for invoicing (please send).
3) Evidence pack: procurement asked for an audit snapshot (log retention policy and where audit logs are stored) to attach to their vendor file. Can you provide a short paragraph describing logs and retention?

If those answers are fine we will issue a PO by 12/10 to align internal approvals.

Maya Ramirez
Vendor Operations | EdgeScale
procure@edgescale.com
